entities.name: Růžena Zátková
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Růžena Zátková was a Czech painter and sculptor. She has been regarded as the "only authentic Czech futurist." As a result of her Bohemian heritage and her decade-long residency in Rome, Růžena Zátková became an important artistic link between Russian and Italian Futurism. Zátková is considered one of the pioneers of kinetic art.
